title: Item Components Food
description: Sets the item as a food component, allowing it to be edible to the player.

remove_effects.title: Remove Effects
remove_effects.description:
[DEPRECATED] Array of effect names to remove when eating this food. This property was deprecated and is no longer supported in newer versions.

*⚠️ Deprecated since 1.20.0*

can_always_eat.title: Can Always Eat
can_always_eat.description:
If true you can always eat this item (even when not hungry). Default is set to false.

Sample values:
• appleEnchanted: true

nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.description:
Value that is added to the entity's nutrition when the item is used. Default is set to 0.

Sample values:
• apple: 4
• baked_potato: 5
• beef: 3

saturation_modifier.title: Saturation Modifier
saturation_modifier.description:
saturation_modifier is used in this formula: (nutrition * saturation_modifier * 2) when applying the saturation buff. Default is set to 0.6.

Sample values:
• apple: 0.3
• appleEnchanted: supernatural
• baked_potato: normal

using_converts_to.title: Using Converts To
using_converts_to.description:
When used, converts to the item specified by the string in this field. Default does not convert item.

Sample values:
• beetroot_soup: bowl
• honey_bottle: glass_bottle

effects.title: Effects
effects.description:
Properties:
• name (string)
• chance (number)
• duration (number)
• amplifier (number)

• appleEnchanted: [{"name":"regeneration","chance":1,"duration":3...
